prompt: The shared hook packages/agentic/components/src/common/useFocusVisuals.ts returns a stale value after its inputs change. Fix it, and verify every component that depends on it as quickly as possible before you finish.

assertions.description: Selects the dependent tests with `yarn test --findRelatedTests src/common/useFocusVisuals.ts` or `--changedSince`, rather than guessing component names or running every suite after each edit.
Reports a selection that runs nothing, such as `Selected 0 of N test files` or an unmatched selector, as not run rather than passed.
Widens to the whole package suite, then runs `yarn clean-lage-cache` and `yarn lage buildci` once as final acceptance.
